name: image_compress
title: Compress image to WebP/AVIF
summary: Compress and resize an image into WebP or AVIF.
input: one of `source_url` (public URL), `upload_id` (from `create_upload`) or `data_base64` (up to 512 KB); `format` webp/avif, `quality`, `width`, `height`, `preset`, `lossless`.

name: image_convert
title: Convert image format
summary: Convert an image between PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, TIFF and GIF, optionally capping the longest side.

name: pdf_to_images
title: PDF to images
summary: Render PDF pages to PNG, JPEG or WebP (up to 20 pages, up to 20 MB).
output: `pages`, `files[{n, resource_link, bytes}]`, preview of page 1, `expires_at`; or a `handle` for long jobs.

name: create_upload
title: Create a one-time upload URL
summary: Get a one-time `PUT` URL to upload a local file (agents with a shell: Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code).
